description: This file defines the 'ValueValidator' interface, which provides methods for validating header values in a chainable manner within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes method signatures for value validation, type checking, and chaining validators.

classes.name: ValueValidator
classes.description: An interface for validating header values, supporting chaining of multiple validators via the 'andThen' method.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Validates the given value based on the provided header definition. Throws an exception if validation fails.

methods.name: canValidate
methods.description: Checks if the validator can handle values of a specified type.

methods.name: andThen
methods.description: Creates a composite validator that applies this validator and then another specified validator.
